(Currently Amended) Claim 281: A tool comprising: a lamination of at least two layers, a first adhesive layer and a second adhesive layer located on opposite sides of a medial section, wherein the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are in registration with each other.

(Original) Claim 282: The tool of claim 281 wherein the medial section is formed from a metal.

(Original) Claim 283: The tool of claim 282 wherein the metal is a honeycomb structure.

(Original) Claim 284: The tool of claim 281 wherein the medial section is formed from a composite material.

(Original) Claim 285: The tool of claim 281 further comprising a weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers.

(Original) Claim 286: The tool of claim 285 wherein the weld ring is bonded to the medial section.

(Original) Claim 287: The tool of claim 285 wherein a plurality of cutting segments are welded to an outer perimeter of the weld ring.

(Original) Claim 288: The tool of claim 281 wherein the weld ring is continuous. 

(Original) Claim 290: The tool of claim 285 further comprising an inner ring, wherein the medial section is coupled on an inner perimeter to the inner ring.

(Amended) Claim 291: The tool of claim 290 wherein the inner ring includes a central opening.
